task: In Production, create an experiment metric named "add_to_cart" that records whether the event "add_to_cart_clicked" happened at least once per user. Higher is better.
finalText: FAILED: The metric was not created in Production. The create_metric endpoint rejects every request with "definition: This field is required." The tool's schema does not expose a `definition` property, so I could not supply the event definition in a form the server accepts. A search for "add_to_cart" in Production returns no metrics, so nothing was left behind. This needs either a fix to the tool's definition field or creating the metric in the Flagsmith UI with the event "add_to_cart_clicked", aggregation "occurrence", and direction "up".
